verify.description: Run repo-wide checks (format + lint) before finishing work
verify.template: Run `pnpm format` and `pnpm lint` from the repo root, fix any issues they surface, and only stop after both pass.

scaffold.description: Scaffold a new app package under apps/ following repo conventions
scaffold.template: Scaffold a new app in `apps/$1` as a pnpm workspace package. Follow repo conventions: Prettier style (4-space indent, no semicolons, single quotes, trailingComma es5), ESLint flat config is repo-wide, and apps are run per-package via `pnpm -F <name>`. Do not add root scripts.
